name: Jade Sentinel / 青铜守卫
provenance: Original procedural demonstration. No Tripo or Seedance generation was invoked.
rig: Custom armature with explicit vertex-group weights; not Rigify.
limitations: Segmented rigid armor with explicit bone weights; no automatic weight quality benchmark.
Walk is an in-place cycle; foot locking and root motion need further refinement.
The FBX export has not been validated in Unity.
